We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template as result of task make_8_lvl2-template_search-4 to the molecule. The template_search-4 gave mapped_rxn and template_id 1141. So we need to apply template 1141 to the target molecule (the same SMILES as earlier? The molecule from make_8_lvl2-apply_template-3 is "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1F". So we need to apply template 1141 to that molecule. Use apply_template tool.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles and template_id "1141".
